trailhead.label: Chemin des Parchets at Plaine-Joux, by a water tap, about 200 m east of the Plaine-Joux car park (321 chemin des Parchets), where the tourist office starts the walk

cautions: The paved access road from the Plaine-Joux car park, crossed once on the loop.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
